title: Planning Your Dream Wedding at Royal Phuket City Hotel
content:
Your wedding day should be nothing short of magical, and at Royal Phuket City Hotel, we have been creating unforgettable celebrations for over 27 years.

Our Wedding Venues

Our Grand Ballroom features elegant high ceilings adorned with gorgeous chandeliers, creating a sophisticated atmosphere for up to 500 guests. The versatile space can be transformed to match any color scheme or floor plan you envision.

Comprehensive Services

Our dedicated team includes:

  • Professional wedding coordinators
  • On-site banquet and catering teams
  • Technical and audio-visual support
  • Security personnel

The Bridal Suite

Prepare for your special moment in our spacious, private Bridal Suite complete with your own private restroom and stunning mirrors for those perfect getting-ready photos.

Guest Convenience

With over 350 parking spaces and 251 elegant guest rooms, your guests will enjoy the utmost convenience throughout your celebration.

When you shortlist a reception setting, bring our Phuket wedding reception venue visit checklist to discuss the layout, guest journey, catering and written proposal for your own date.
